newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent drifts at higher levels, awaits EIA data.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent drifts at higher levels, awaits EIA data.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were drifting sideways at higher levels on Wednesday after the release of neutral to bullish stocks data from the U.S., traders said.
June Brent stood at $18.19 a barrel at 1150 GMT, 12 cents up on the day, while May gas oil was 25 cents a tonne down at $166.25.
"It is desperately quiet, stuck in the middle of the morning's range," one IPE dealer said.

Traders said they were awaiting the opening of the U.S. market and the release later on Wednesday of weekly stocks data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), because many were sceptical about the data released on Tuesday night by the American Petroleum Institute (API).
One broker described API figures showing "implied demand" for gasoline at a record 8.76 million barrels per day as "a bit weird" and dealers thought the figure should be lower.
Brokers said that the market's failure to break support on Tuesday had reinforced technical support for the market and encouraged bullish sentiment.
